text: A DBA interview rarely asks "define an index." It asks something closer to real work — clarify the constraint, name the relevant tool, explain the trade-off, then state what you'd verify afterward.

The database is suddenly slow — start with methodology, not a guess. A query was fast yesterday, slow today — that's Query Store's exact job. Twelve real scenarios like these, spanning everything this course covered.
RPO is how much recent work you could lose. RTO is how long you'd be down. Dropping the jargon on request, in two plain sentences, is itself a real interview signal.

95 lessons, 16 chapters — this completes the Azure Database Administrator path's Job-Ready stage, alongside T-SQL Development, Azure Fundamentals, and Data Factory. The Advanced stage still has PowerShell Fundamentals ahead of it.
Course complete. Congratulations on finishing Azure Database Administrator.
